label: NFHS Fast-Pitch Softball (generic U.S. high school)

_source_notes.lineup.reentryPolicy: ANY_PLAYER_ONCE (broader than baseball's starter-centric rule) -- spec Sec.9 'Primary distinction: NFHS fast-pitch softball permits a broader one-time re-entry model than baseball: a player may be withdrawn and re-entered once, provided the player returns to the same batting-order position.' The state machine (reentryCount, same-batting-position validation) is P1+ engine work.
_source_notes.lineup.dpFlexPolicy: NFHS_2026 is a version tag, not the policy itself -- spec Sec.9.2/9.3 define the full DP/FLEX transition table (DP-plays-defense-for-FLEX, FLEX-bats-for-DP, the HARD invariant that DP and FLEX can never both be active on offense simultaneously) as P1+ lineup-service state-machine work, not ruleset data. Optional per spec: 'If DP/FLEX is used, it must exist in the starting lineup model' -- a given softball game may still run a plain 9-player lineup.
_source_notes.lineup.courtesyRunnerPolicy.enabled: SUPERSEDED (P2 followup, 2026-09-14, owner decision): the engine no longer gates courtesy-runner entry by this value at all -- lineup_service.enter_courtesy_runner() is a universal operator option for every association, any player, any time, replacing the jurisdiction-specific adoption model this field originally described. Left in place, still false, purely as a historical/documentary artifact; nothing reads it. The original spec framing (Sec.10 'Policy is jurisdiction-specific'; Sec.16's first-inning-details-change-for-2027 note; MHSAA's actual postseason enablement as a state overlay) is what this decision explicitly replaces.
_source_notes.runnerControl.lookBackRule: true: fast-pitch softball's look-back rule can produce an umpire-declared out on a live-ball baserunning judgment call. Per spec Sec.9.4/Sec.14.2, CSRN must never infer this out automatically -- record only via a LOOK_BACK_RULING umpire-ruling event (P1+ engine work). This field only signals that the rule exists in this ruleset's sport.
_source_notes.communications.defensiveOneWayRecipients: ['CATCHER'] only for the 2026 season -- spec Sec.16/18: 'One-way coach-to-catcher communication on defense permitted in 2026; 2027 expands to pitcher + catcher.' Do not add PITCHER here until a 2027-dated ruleset document is created; spec Sec.18 explicitly warns against retrofitting 2027 changes into 2026 profiles.
